INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.evidence: Section14:61-77,217; prior BP-F07. The candidate guarantees atomic idempotency and grant recheck, but does not define same-key identity/payload/precondition mismatch semantics.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: An authenticated caller retries the same key with changed patch bytes or another target. A generic key lookup returns the former receipt even though the attempted operation differs; a revoked caller can retrieve restricted prior outcome metadata if retry lookup precedes current authorization.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.required_disposition: Extend STU-ARC011 or owning canonical request contract: bind idempotency identity to principal/account, project/resource/action, canonical payload hash and original target preconditions. Same-key mismatch returns typed conflict without prior restricted metadata. Authorized identical retry returns committed receipt after fresh resource authorization; never remutate.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.proof: Cross-principal/resource/payload/revision same-key cases; revoke between commit and retry; real record-user canonical reread proves one patch/event/receipt and no restricted receipt disclosure.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.evidence: Section14:217-221; module Session key at703. Prior BP-F01/F05/F08 and proposed shutdown/cancellation contracts.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: Cancel or timeout occurs after durable commit but before receipt. The caller reports canceled and retries with a new key; or old worker returns after actor restart and advances stale state. During shutdown, outstanding reservation/completion ownership prevents drain while actor awaits work replying to its mailbox.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.required_disposition: Define before-commit cancellation versus committed/outcome-unknown results. Timeout never asserts rollback until canonical reconciliation; postcommit cancel cannot erase accepted edit. Epoch-fence stale restarted worker completions. Close admission, service reserved completion/cancel, checkpoint/reconcile accepted identities, retain bytes/worker/device permits until actual retirement, and never actor-await work needing its own mailbox to deliver.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.proof: Crash before/at/after transaction and before acknowledgment; saturate all lanes; restart actor with old completion; drain with reserved permits. Independent canonical read/replay and permit accounting verify exact terminal outcomes.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.evidence: Section14:221,241; module ScorePlugin at864. Prior PDF-AUDIO002/003 trace playback CaptureStates to foreign save and ambiguous empty timeout.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: Foreign state capture times out off callback and returns empty state as success; delivery reopens older audible state. A retired plugin cannot return through saturated handoff and its destructor executes on realtime or wrong-affinity thread. Send+Sync port law at187 is mistaken for permission to move arbitrary foreign instances between threads.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.required_disposition: Keep Send+Sync on safe facade/command ports, not unproven foreign instances. Define state capture graph revision, per-instance completeness/error/deadline/blob budget and plugin API thread affinity/quiescence. Reserve bounded reclamation capacity before transfer, retain receiver until all instances are reclaimed on permitted thread, and refuse required incomplete state for successful delivery. Native crash/hang containment limits remain explicit.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.proof: Real changed audible-state save/reopen; capture timeout/oversize/stale graph; close/full return channel; instrument foreign save/process/destroy thread and exactly-once reclamation.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.evidence: Module Score/Session/Reel foundation text and Section14:221. Prior PDF-AUDIO010 exact Sound mix1496-1503 versus engine/io221-236 silently-clamped bounce.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.counterexample: A long/high-rate/multichannel export is under request-duration limit but render byte/sample cap shortens it and encoder still returns success. Generic bounded processing/typed loss wording does not explicitly reconcile requested versus delivered frames.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.required_disposition: Require requested and delivered sample/frame range, channel layout/rate/timebase and completeness in delivery receipts. Limits must reject before work or use bounded streaming preserving full range; explicit approved partial outcome cannot be labeled complete. Block-boundary cancellation and discontinuities must preserve exact positions. Add exact frame-count acceptance to Score and delivery MTs.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.proof: Independent decoded artifact frame count/timecode/duration/channel verification for ranges crossing caps, with no source-sized full-buffer allocation; disk-full/cancel/partial encoder paths never emit complete success.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.evidence: Section14:237 full-save policy; module Press at786. Prior PDF-AUDIO007 automation647-652 versus cos writer178-179.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.required_disposition: Press writer/delivery result must carry actual executed save mode and policy reason separately from requested mode, output digest and exported revision. Preserve forced-full redaction safeguard and do not rebase current authority to stale export bytes.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.proof: Redacted/reconstructed/encryption-changed incremental request; independent output revision-chain inspection matches receipt. Late export completion leaves newer committed revision intact.
